purpose: Native reproduction of the btc-strategy-lab published claim, on its own terms.
separation_rule: A native historical reproduction must not silently become a Dataset V2 experiment. This dataset is locked separately and is never mixed with Dataset V2 in one record.

native_conditions_from_upstream.stated: BTC/USDT spot, 1h candles, 0.1% fee per side, no leverage, single position, 8 years of data

acquisition.route: official public Binance data archive, the same route that acquired Dataset V2; no exchange credential is used or required

reproduction_grade_rule.rule: If the exact historical inputs upstream used cannot be reconstructed, REPRODUCTION_GRADE must reflect that.
reproduction_grade_rule.never: Do not call an approximate reconstruction exact.
known_unknowns: upstream's exact download date, and therefore which revisions of Binance's archive it saw
upstream's exact backtest end date - the README states 8 years without pinning a boundary
whether upstream applied any pair or candle filtering not visible in the pinned scripts

integrity_contract.note: Same definition as Dataset V2's, so the two are directly comparable even though they are never merged.
